text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, just as I was passing by
the hallway in front of an empty classroom――
choice_data_list: (Is that... the sound of a violin?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but stop and listen――
The notes of a violin, so delicate and beautiful,
resonated softly against my eardrums.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as a complete novice when it comes to music,
I can grasp it instinctively.
What an astonishing level of mastery...!

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Whoa! The one playing the violin was Daiichi Ruby-san...?!

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... I feel like my ears just got classy just listening...
Haaah, that's the "Illustrious Clan" for you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume passed by while chatting.
As I stood captivated listening even as the sound
of their footsteps faded into the distance—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Did you need something from me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Daiichi Ruby, having finished her performance before I even realized,
was standing right in front of me!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...If the sound disturbed your work or anything, I am terribly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Normally, I borrow soundproof rooms such as the vocal practice rooms,
but unfortunately, they were fully booked today.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Be that as it may, practice has concluded. You should be able to spend the rest of your time in peace and quiet.
choice_data_list: N-No, that's not what I meant...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I really want to convey that I was simply enraptured by how soothing it sounded.
Here goes――
choice_data_list: Praise their skills to the fullest!
Convey your honest feelings with full force!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mustering every scrap of knowledge I had, I somehow managed to praise her playing technique! However...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am honored. Thank you very much.
...Now, if you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: L-Low temperature~...

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Honestly though, don't you think she's sick of hearing it?
Those kinds of generic compliments, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if you don't grasp technical intricacies, music comes from the heart!
And so I poured my feelings out with everything I had.
However...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am honored. Thank you very much.
...Now, if you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: T-Talk about cool-headed...

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Nah~ but haven't you noticed? You never see her like...
that fancy ojou-sama getting, like,
all emotional and stuff, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, feeling a bit "sigh, good grief..." as I headed towards the stairs to get back to work—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear it too? Me too.
It's rare for sound to echo all the way up to the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
As always, a beautiful tone.
Beautiful—and yet, terribly suffocating.
